takeaways: Data silos are mainly a cultural and governance problem: departments hoarding their own spreadsheets and dashboards create competing versions of the truth.
Embedding Power BI in Teams, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and SharePoint removes context switching and brings live, shared data into the places where decisions are made.
Microsoft Fabric and OneLake provide one shared data layer and semantic model, while Purview and sensitivity labels keep shared datasets governed.
hook: Finance, sales and HR all bring different numbers to the same meeting? This episode is for Microsoft 365 leaders, analysts and admins who want to end version wars and data silos. Learn how embedding Power BI in everyday apps and unifying data with Fabric and OneLake turns analytics into shared, trusted decisions.
